trawl.definition:
n. a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)
n. a conical fishnet dragged through the water at great depths
v. fish with trawlers
trawl.translation:
n. 拖网
v. 用拖网捕鱼

trawlboat.definition: n. A boat used in fishing with trawls or trawlnets.

trawled.translation: v. （在…）以拖网捕鱼( trawl的过去式和过去分词 ); 查阅（档案等）

trawler.definition:
n. a fisherman who use a trawl net
n. a fishing boat that uses a trawl net or dragnet to catch fish
trawler.translation:
n. 拖网渔船
[法] 拖网船, 拖网捕鱼的船, 拖网捕鱼的人

trawlerman.definition:
n. A fisherman who used unlawful arts and engines to catch
   fish.
trawlerman.translation: n. 拖网渔民, 拖网渔船工人(或船员)

trawlermen.translation: n. 拖网渔民, 拖网渔船工人（或船员）( trawlerman的名词复数 )

trawlers.definition:
n. a fisherman who use a trawl net
n. a fishing boat that uses a trawl net or dragnet to catch fish
trawlers.translation: n. 拖网渔船( trawler的复数形式 ); 拖网捕鱼者, 拖网渔民

trawling.translation: v. （在…）以拖网捕鱼( trawl的现在分词 ); 查阅（档案等）

trawls.definition:
n a long fishing line with many shorter lines and hooks attached to it (usually suspended between buoys)
n a conical fishnet dragged through the water at great depths
v fish with trawlers
trawls.translation:
n. 拖网( trawl的名词复数 ); 排钩绳
v. （在…）以拖网捕鱼( trawl的第三人称单数 ); 查阅（档案等）
